definition: to get something into your hands
description: A cardboard box with FREE STUFF written on the side stands on a low garden wall in a quiet suburban street. A cyclist in a racing jersey and helmet reaches in and lifts a table lamp out of it. A bearded man in a hoodie reaches in and lifts out an American football. An elderly woman with a walking stick lifts out a terracotta plant pot. Finally a young man with a backpack looks into the empty box, picks up the box itself and carries it away down the pavement.

to grab a stack of books
